facts.text: Grand Hotel d'Angkor opened in 1932.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hotel d’Angkor opened its doors in 1932

facts.text: The hotel was built in French Art Deco style with local influences.
facts.excerpt: constructed in the finest French Art Deco style with local influences

facts.text: The original timber elevator in the lobby is described as the oldest lift in Indochina.
facts.excerpt: The original timber elevator in the lobby - the oldest lift in Indochina

facts.text: In 2019 the hotel underwent an extensive renovation that restored its rooms, suites and architectural features.
facts.excerpt: In 2019 the hotel underwent an extensive renovation, which saw its 119 rooms and suites and other architectural features restored to their former glory.

facts.text: The hotel is in the Old French Quarter of Siem Reap, facing the Royal Palace and close to the Angkor National Museum.
facts.excerpt: Grand Hotel d'Angkor's location in the leafy Old French Quarter of Siem Reap, facing the Royal Palace and close to the Angkor National Museum

facts.text: The temples of Angkor are an 8 km ride from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: an 8 km ride to the fabled temples of Angkor

facts.text: The new Siem Reap International Airport is 48 km from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: the new Siem Reap International Airport is 48 km away

facts.text: Every stay is accompanied by a personal butler.
facts.excerpt: Every stay at Raffles Grand Hotel d’Angkor is accompanied by a personal butler.

facts.text: Personality Suites take their inspiration from people closely associated with Angkor.
facts.excerpt: Specially created Personality Suites take their inspiration from people who have been closely associated with Angkor.

facts.text: Restaurant 1932 offers four tasting menus conceived by Siem Reap native Chef Dorn Doeurt with Executive Chef Memo Hernandez.
facts.excerpt: four sensitively curated tasting menus, all of them conceived by Siem Reap native Chef Dorn Doeurt with Executive Chef Memo Hernandez

facts.text: Herbs and spices for Restaurant 1932 are gathered daily in the hotel gardens.
facts.excerpt: The fragrant herbs and spices are gathered daily in the hotel gardens

facts.text: Afternoon Tea is served in the conservatory with a resident pianist.
facts.excerpt: Afternoon Tea is served in the conservatory with a resident pianist

facts.text: Elephant Bar cocktail hour is described as a Siem Reap institution.
facts.excerpt: Elephant Bar cocktail hour is a Siem Reap institution

facts.text: The swimming pool was modelled after the ancient baths of Angkor.
facts.excerpt: swimming pool that was modelled after the ancient baths of Angkor

facts.text: Raffles Spa offers authentic Khmer massages alongside modern treatments.
facts.excerpt: Our menu features authentic Khmer massages alongside modern treatments to soothe the senses.

facts.text: The hotel has two professional tennis courts with a resident coach.
facts.excerpt: Train with our resident coach on two professional tennis courts.

facts.text: The hotel's events space hosts traditional Khmer dance performances every Saturday night.
facts.excerpt: hosting traditional Khmer dance performances every Saturday night

facts.text: Guests can visit a shrine in the hotel's gardens to be blessed with good fortune.
facts.excerpt: You can visit their shrine in the 15-acre gardens to be blessed with good fortune.

facts.text: Doormen wear silk pantaloons whose colour changes according to the day of the week, following a Royal Guard tradition.
facts.excerpt: Following a Royal Guard tradition, our doormen wear silk pantaloons whose colour changes according to which day of the week it is.

facts.text: The ideal time to visit is November to February, when the weather is cooler.
facts.excerpt: The ideal time is from November to February, when the weather is cooler and perfect for exploring the temples and local culture.

facts.text: Restaurant 1932 has a dress code; slip-ons and flip-flops are not permitted.
facts.excerpt: Slip-ons and flip-flops are not permitted.

facts.text: A VIP luncheon at the hotel culminated in the announcement of UN-sponsored elections in Cambodia.
facts.excerpt: culminates in the announcement that UN-sponsored elections will be held in Cambodia in May 1993

facts.text: Restaurant 1932 is called the only place in Siem Reap to develop a taste for Khmer cuisine.
facts.excerpt: Restaurant 1932 is the only place in Siem Reap where one can develop a taste for the distinct flavours of Khmer cuisine.
